claims_disputed.claim: The study is a reproducible public-discourse analysis with an auditable corpus
claims_disputed.reason: Data availability says the register, codebook, matrix, and SHA-256 manifest are prepared for Zenodo and GitHub. No URL or DOI is in the paper, transcripts are withheld, and §6.9 is a single coder by design. A described protocol without the corpus is not a reproducibility result.

pattern_stance_changes.reason: §8.1 and §10.1 prescribe intent, constraints, and acceptance evidence as the unit of work. That is a spec-first proposal. It is not only a label for other people's remarks, and it is not a comparison, so it does not rise to supports.
Table 6 stage 2 and §10.1 tell leaders to set review rules and escalation criteria for agent autonomy. That prescribes a human gate. No gated-versus-ungated comparison is run.

missed_issues: P39 is untagged. Stage 4 and §10.2 say requirements, decision records, interface contracts, and threat models should become retrievable context for agents. That is a machine-readable-context proposal with no measurement.
P42 is untagged. Stage 4 says acceptance evidence becomes continuous and traceable. No link is checked.
Table 5's support counts (7 to 25 artifacts) have no stated corpus size, so the same artifact can sit in several themes and the counts cannot be read as coverage.

The HTML header says Journal of Systems and Software while the data note is still a planned release. The review records the empty journal_ref; the header still reads as a publication the paper does not have.
note: The review is right that every measured-sounding sentence is an interpretation, that ordinary engineers are outside the sample, and that the maturity path is a projection. It is too harsh in marking the practice sections as mere mentions: §10 prescribes spec-first work and human escalation, which is introduces, not a tested support. It is slightly kind to the reproducibility claim, which has no artifact. Blind rigor is 1 because there is no new measurement and the corpus cannot be inspected; under the loader that minimum rejects the paper even though the review's rigor was 2. Use the section 10 checklist only as a restatement of requirements, architecture rationale, and review, not as evidence for a harness change.
